verdict.rationale: LibreChat's first-party docs describe an in-product Agents feature, built in the Agent Builder side panel and invoked from the endpoint menu or by @-mention. These agents can handle files, interpret code, call API actions and use MCP tools, so a user can hand tasks to an assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents completing delegated tasks, and detail on multi-step autonomy (the Subagents page appears in the pack only as a title).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: LibreChat's AI Agents feature provides a flexible framework for creating custom AI assistants powered by various model providers.
Advanced agents with file handling, code interpretation, and API actions
Existing agents can be selected from the top dropdown of the Side Panel. Also by mention with "@" in the chat input.
LibreChat leverages MCP to dramatically expand what your AI agents can do, allowing you to integrate everything from file system access, web browsers, specialized APIs, to custom business tools.
